en.t: After reciting the poem, his sorrow only deepened.

units.source_text: 此时正在举行祭典，门外车水马龙，喧嚣之声不绝。

en.t: At that time a festival was being held, and outside the gate carriages and horses streamed past while the noise never ceased.

units.source_text: 但柏木如同不闻，只管沉浸在自己所造成的痛苦中，寂寞地度送了一天。

en.t: But Kashiwagi seemed not to hear any of it, remaining absorbed in the pain he himself had caused, and passed the day in lonely misery.

units.source_text: 落叶公主看见他镇日愁眉苦脸，不知所为何事。

en.t: Princess Ochiba saw him looking gloomy all day, but did not know what had brought it on.

units.source_text: 她但觉可耻又可恼，所以并不问他，只在心中悲叹。

en.t: She felt only shame and resentment, so she did not ask him, but grieved silently in her heart.

units.source_text: 此时众侍女都出去观礼了，室中人影寥寥。

en.t: By then all the ladies in attendance had gone out to watch the ceremony, and there were very few people left in the room.

units.source_text: 落叶公主纳闷之余，取过筝来，弹了一支美妙的乐曲，那神情毕竟十分高雅。

en.t: Troubled and perplexed, Princess Ochiba took up the koto and played a beautiful piece, and her bearing was still exceedingly refined.

units.source_text: 但柏木听了筝声，并不感动，

en.t: But when Kashiwagi heard the sound of the koto, he was not moved.

units.source_text: 他还是在想：“同是公主，我因差了一点，不曾娶得那一位，真乃前世命定。”

en.t: He was still thinking, "Though both are princesses, because I fell just a little short, I could not marry that other one. It must truly have been destined from a former life."
